name: Vigil helm library
revision: 0.1 · swappable helms on 1.6 mm D-flat pegs
description: Swappable helm designs for the Vigilant troopers, each named by identifier: VH-01 Vigil, VH-02 Warden, VH-03 Breacher, VH-04 Seeker, VH-05 Sentinel, VH-06 Raptor, VH-07 Diver, VH-08 Hunter, VH-09 Bulwark, VH-10 Specter. Every helm has the same 1.6 mm D-flat neck peg, so any helm fits any trooper.
buildNotes: Defined in tools/armory.py (HELMS registry); built by tools/bitspack.py.
Lens and visor recesses are at least 0.25 mm deep; crests and fins at least 0.7 mm thick.
limitations: Procedural designs; printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print.

mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)

printability.summary: vh-01-vigil: minimum wall (supported) = 5.7911 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); vh-02-warden: minimum wall (supported) = 5.9129 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); vh-04-seeker: minimum wall (supported) = 8.5132 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); vh-05-sentinel: minimum wall (supported) = 1.2974 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); vh-07-diver: minimum wall (supported) = 0.5201
